title: The Devil's Mouth
plot_overview: A group of college friends on a Thailand adventure become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen dwindles, mounting danger and old tensions test their ability to work together and survive the perilous underwater maze.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you want a simple underwater creature thriller with trapped friends and escalating danger; Not for you if you need deep characters, consistent tension, or polished storytelling.
review_summary: Pros: tense cave setting; fast-paced survival premise; straightforward creature thrills | Cons: weak character writing; uneven pacing; little emotional weight
